channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Antithrombotic drugs may help prevent migraine in patients with PFO
item.description: Aspirin, clopidogrel, and rivaroxaban were non-inferior to metoprolol in responder rate for patients with patent foramen ovale.

item.title: Unused medicines could fill 75 swimming pools
item.description: Pharmacists urge more medication reviews to reduce the £480 million wasted annually by the NHS in England.

item.title: Plastic packaging may increase fatty liver risk from unhealthy diets
item.description: Microplastics are widespread, and scientists are studying their potential health effects, including links to fatty liver disease.

item.title: Malaria vaccine boosters target three antibodies, study shows
item.description: Malaria kills over 500,000 people annually, mostly African children. Two WHO-recommended vaccines are available.
